title: Use a large jump
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Two electrons are removed before core removal begins.
statement:
Successive ionization energies jump strongly between IE₂ and IE₃. How many valence electrons are suggested for a main-group element?

[_]{a}

explanations: Both initial removals reach valence electrons.
The third removal is the first core removal.
This would imply a jump between the first and second.
The jump occurs before four removals.
